source_contract.source_guard: Exact lock and transfer/reactor/liburing_file/author kv_offload base bytes read and SHA checked at beginning and end of every verification; no source modules imported.

supported_subset.layout: Contiguous canonical pages only; layer-major then storage-local block, with page stride equal to page bytes. Source and consumer GPU block IDs may differ while storage-local position must match.
supported_subset.partial_skip: Rejected; first_block_index must equal zero and each file has exactly factor pages.
supported_subset.logical_vs_physical: Pinned original allocate_staging_buffer requires logical storage_block_bytes divisible by 4096. Supported SSD physical bytes therefore equal logical bytes and outer padding is zero. Unaligned layout or an extra padding tail is rejected; no invented padding policy.

content_checks: Five producer/D2H/SSD-write/SSD-read/restored capture SHA declarations recomputed from actual immutable fixture bytes.
Producer pages match D2H layer-major slices; both SSD captures match D2H; restored pages match producer local block correspondence.
Prefix/token block hash is only an association key and is not conflated with payload SHA. Original OffloadKey hash plus four-byte big-endian group zero required.
association_and_order: Exact CPU stage records require run, store/load job pair, file index, key and block IDs; unique positive sequence with producer capture -> D2H completed -> SSD write completed -> SSD capture -> SSD read completed -> H2D completed -> consumer capture -> model compute. CPU-declared completion bits are fixture assertions and never native proof.

authority_boundary.accepted_input: Exact CPUFixtureBundle dataclasses only; origin/native/qualified receipt arguments unsupported. Unknown object types are rejected before reading owner attributes.
authority_boundary.returned_input_retention: No raw payload, tensor, owner, Future, input bundle or source path object returned; only immutable scalar summaries and fixed source refs.
missing_runtime_provenance: Actual CUDA tensors, shape and raw page capture identity
Original D2H/H2D event completion and staging provenance
Actual SSD path and completed write/read physical payload provenance
Consumer restore capture before original model compute
Live original owner/job registration and actual capture installer

changes_to_original_engine: None. No synchronization, transfer_async, get_finished, shutdown, hook installation, policy activation, model change, GPU scope creation, permission or ledger changes.

first_attempt.reason: Scalar-only test AST included a __future__ import with restricted builtins lacking __import__. Test harness repaired to compile the unchanged pinned scalar AST with annotations compiler flag. Module and original sources unchanged.

next_stage: Independent CPU boundary review and actual server stdlib replay. Future native byte capture must be implemented, source-bound and separately GPU-authorized before any real byte qualification; this candidate does not supply that authority.
